repairs.rule: A one-way closed loop is drawn closed; a stop the service does not call at gets no dot.

rail_transit_map_analysis_18_cities (2026-09-09) pdx:pattern:A: closed_loop=true.
The closing geometry's corner vertex is interpolated on the package's own former NW 13th-to-9th Lovejoy centreline row, at the NW 10th Ave longitude.
